title: Status vocabulary and visual mapping
statement: Every domain state MUST render as a text label from the versioned status catalog, wrapped in a Forma status-lozenge whose data-state is derived by rule: ok = authoritative final success (Settled, Final, Approved, Accepted); attention = waiting on a named party or action; unknown = outcome or evidence not determinable (PaymentOutcomeUnknown, EvidenceStale, Disputed); blocked = held, blocked, rejected, failed or ineligible. No state may be conveyed by colour alone, and no record may display a final-success label until the authoritative component has recorded the final state.

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment attempt whose provider outcome is Unknown
acceptance_criteria.then: the label reads 'Payment outcome unknown' with data-state=unknown, and no screen shows 'Paid'

acceptance_criteria.given: a grant in state EligibilityHold
acceptance_criteria.then: the label reads 'On hold: charity eligibility' with data-state=blocked and a text reason

origin: ui-refinement 2026-11-23 (owner instruction: make designs more concrete)

title: Five-dimension grant progress
statement: Grant status MUST be shown as five ordered dimensions (Recommendation, Eligibility, Approval, Funding, Payment), each with its own label and as-of time, using Forma steps for the sequence and status-lozenge for each dimension. A single headline status MUST be derived deterministically: the first dimension that is not final, except that any Unknown or Blocked dimension becomes the headline.

acceptance_criteria.given: Eligibility = Eligible, Approval = Approved, Funding = FundingPlanned, Payment = not started
acceptance_criteria.then: headline is 'Funding in progress' (attention)

acceptance_criteria.given: Payment = Unknown while Funding = Funded
acceptance_criteria.then: headline is 'Payment outcome unknown' (unknown)

origin: ui-refinement 2026-11-23 (owner instruction: make designs more concrete)

title: Freshness of evidence and projections
statement: Every value derived from external evidence or from an asynchronous projection MUST show a Forma freshness element with its as-of time. When the value is older than its configured freshness limit it MUST be labelled 'Not current' (unknown) and MUST NOT be offered as the basis for a consequential action.

acceptance_criteria.when: viewed the next business day at 17:00
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows 'Not current' and the Recommend grant action uses authoritative available-to-grant instead

title: Authoritative amounts versus informational values
statement: Fund screens MUST show 'Available to grant' (authoritative capacity computed by the ledger, UNB-RCN-FIN-009) separately from 'Market value' (informational, with freshness) and 'Pending' (reserved or in-flight), and MUST never sum them into a single unlabeled balance.

acceptance_criteria.then: Available to grant shows $100,000 with a 'How this is calculated' disclosure listing the three components

title: Consequential action confirmation
statement: Every action of authority class A2 or higher MUST present, before submission, a confirmation dialog that states what will change, whether it is reversible, who acts next and the expected time to the next state. The confirm control MUST name the action (for example 'Submit grant recommendation'), not 'OK'.

acceptance_criteria.given: a donor submits a $5,000 grant
acceptance_criteria.then: a dialog lists amount, charity, fund, 'Your sponsor approves this grant; you can withdraw until approval', and the button reads 'Submit grant recommendation'

origin: ui-refinement 2026-11-23 (owner instruction: make designs more concrete)

title: Unknown command outcome handling
statement: When a command returns no definite outcome (Limen OutcomeUnknown, timeout or 5xx after submission), the screen MUST show a Forma operation-status in the unknown state with a 'Check status' action that queries by idempotency key. It MUST NOT automatically retry and MUST NOT show success or failure.

acceptance_criteria.then: the operation-status reads 'We cannot confirm your recommendation was received', and pressing Check status returns the recorded outcome for that idempotency key without creating a second recommendation

statement: All domain nouns in UI, documents, email and assistant output MUST resolve through the sponsor terminology catalog (UNB-RCN-ARC-002). Protected legal statements (the exclusive-legal-control acknowledgment sentence, the advisory-only nature of recommendations, the legal-sponsor disclosure) MUST render verbatim and cannot be overridden.

title: Accessibility conformance
statement: Every screen and document design MUST conform to WCAG 2.2 AA: zero axe-core violations with the wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa and wcag22aa tag sets at 320 CSS px and 1280 CSS px widths; full keyboard operation; visible focus; target size at least 24 by 24 CSS px; and focus moved to the result or error summary after every asynchronous submission.

title: Responsive classification
statement: Each screen MUST be classified phone-complete, phone-review-and-approve, or desktop-first (UNB-RCN-PLT-011). Donor, advisor, successor and approval journeys MUST be phone-complete. No screen may scroll horizontally at 320 CSS px except inside a bounded-overflow or data-grid region.

title: Validation and fault presentation
